# Grade 5 Outdoor Education Camp

May 8, 2026

Riverside Elementary School, Grade 5

Our Grade 5 students will spend two days at Pine Ridge Outdoor Center, learning about the forest and working together as a team. This notice gives the dates, the schedule and the cost.

## Overview

Dates: Thursday, July 9 – Friday, July 10, 2026 (one night)

Location: Pine Ridge Outdoor Center, Cedar County

Students attending: 86

Trip leader: Ms. Rebecca Lindqvist (Grade 5 team lead)

## Day 1 Schedule

| Time | Activity |
| --- | --- |
| 7:45 AM | Meet on the school field for a health check |
| 8:10 AM | Buses leave the school |
| 10:30 AM | Arrive at Pine Ridge, welcome talk |
| 11:00 AM | Outdoor cooking |
| 2:00 PM | Creek walk |
| 6:00 PM | Dinner |
| 7:30 PM | Campfire |

On Day 2, after a morning hike, the buses will be back at school at about 4:00 PM.

## Cost

The camp costs $130 per student. The cost for the whole grade is broken down below.

| Item | Per student | Students | Amount |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lodging and meals | $85 | 86 | $7,310 |
| Activities | $15 | 86 | $1,290 |
| Bus | $30 | 86 | $2,580 |

The cost is paid in two payments:

- First payment: $70, due Friday, May 29, 2026
- Second payment: $60, due Tuesday, June 30, 2026

## What to Send

In addition to the packing list, please send the following four items:

- the health form, signed by a parent
- a pair of work gloves
- a flashlight
- a water bottle (at least 1 liter)

## Questions

Please send any questions about the camp to Ms. Rebecca Lindqvist. On the days of the camp, call the school office at (614) 555-0129 in an emergency, and Ms. Rebecca Lindqvist will call you back from the camp.
